# Sundogs: agent setup

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-distribution.mjs from the main repo. Do not edit by hand. -->

Mini apps for websites on Cloudflare: forms, redirects, popups, timers, reviews and more. Free and paid, installed by your AI coder.

This repository connects AI coding agents to the Sundogs registry (https://sundo.gs). It holds no app code: apps are downloaded from the registry, with a license, into the site owner's own repo.

## Install, one command per client

**Claude Code** (best experience: MCP server, skills and playbooks in one plugin)

```
/plugin marketplace add sundoggs/agent-setup
/plugin install sundogs@sundogs
```

Then run `/mcp`, pick `sundogs` and sign in with the browser. Start with `/sundogs:sundogs what my site needs`. New to Cloudflare, no site yet, or a site on another host? Start with `/sundogs:site-apps-getting-started` instead: a step-by-step setup that picks up where you left off. From a shell the same two steps are `claude plugin marketplace add sundoggs/agent-setup` and `claude plugin install sundogs@sundogs`.

**Codex**

```
codex mcp add sundogs --url https://sundo.gs/mcp
codex mcp login sundogs --scopes catalog:read,download,checkout:create
```

Skills and notes: `codex/README.md`.

**Cursor**: open the install link in `cursor/install-link.txt`, or put `cursor/mcp.json` at `.cursor/mcp.json`. Details: `cursor/README.md`.

**opencode, pi, Hermes Agent, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot**: a ready config in each agent's folder (`opencode/`, `pi/`, `hermes/`, `antigravity/`, `gemini-cli/`, `copilot/`), with an API key from `SITE_APPS_KEY`. Details in each folder's README.

**Any other MCP client**: add the Streamable HTTP server `https://sundo.gs/mcp`. It signs in with the browser (OAuth); for headless use send an API key as `Authorization: Bearer sak_...`.

## What is here

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `plugins/sundogs/` | Claude Code marketplace and plugin: the MCP server, the `site-apps-getting-started`, `sundogs` and `site-apps-update` skills and 19 playbook skills |
| `skills/` | The same skills in the open Agent Skills format, for Codex, Cursor and others (`.agents/skills/`) |
| `codex/` | Codex `config.toml` entry and an `AGENTS.md` section |
| `cursor/` | Cursor `mcp.json`, a rule and an install link |
| `opencode/`, `pi/`, `hermes/`, `antigravity/`, `gemini-cli/`, `copilot/` | A config for each of these agents (API key), with a README |
| `mcp-registry/server.json` | Listing for the official MCP Registry |

Nothing here is sent anywhere by itself. The registry's tools are called by your agent, and the sites it installs never contact Sundogs.
